key_idea: Only 24 hour slots exist, so count for each hour h how many intervals satisfy a<=h<b.
sketch: Keep an array of 24 counters; for every interval [a,b) increment hours a..b-1. Answer is the number of hours whose counter is at least k. O(24n). The only pitfall is treating the interval as half-open: hour b itself is not covered (3 to 14 is 11 hours).
